title: Exemption request
description: A time-boxed Azure Policy exemption for one or more SOLLTE requirements. The pull request that adds the file is the decision record. The rules this schema cannot express (modal verb, groups behind a policy reference, approval, lab scope) are checked by tools/exemptions/exemptions.py.

id.description: Equals the file name without .json and becomes the Azure exemption name.

title.description: Becomes the Azure exemption display name.

requirements.description: Every Grundschutz++ requirement ID the exemption deviates from: all groups of the named policy references.

policyAssignment.description: Name of the policy assignment at the lab resource group, e.g. gspp-corp. Not a resource ID.

policyDefinitionReferenceIds.description: Reference IDs inside the assigned policy set; the exemption covers only these policies.

resourceGroup.description: The lab resource group; validation refuses any other group.

resource.description: Optional single resource in the group, as provider/type/name.

category.description: Waiver: non-compliance temporarily accepted. Mitigated: the intent is met another way (needs compensatingControls).

expiresOn.description: UTC expiry, mandatory in this kit and at most maxDays (default 90) ahead.

riskOwner.description: GitHub login of the person who accepts the risk and must approve the pull request; not its author.

riskStatement.description: What can go wrong while the exemption applies, and for whom.
